clue.text: Thank heavens there's some sign of enduring life

clue.text: CIA hit's ruined by Chinese exercises

clue.text: Broadcast awful record of speech

clue.text: Notice after dark there's a lot of accidents here

explanation.definitionFit: An accident black spot is a stretch of road with an unusually high rate of collisions.

clue.text: Party to start off in pub

clue.text: Hard on old boy with nothing being a tramp

explanation.definitionFit: A hobo is a homeless wanderer, an American word for a vagrant or tramp.

clue.text: Hello article about decoration struck a chord

clue.text: Delish gin cocktail giving superficial confidence?

taken as written

clue.text: Injure leg caught in trap by carelessness
